# ניסן שמריהו

Handyman, plumber, and locksmith serving Or Yehuda and the surrounding area
(Yehud, Kiryat Ono, Savyon, Ganei Tikva, Mazor, Yagel, Lod, Petah Tikva,
Rishon LeZion, Holon — approx. 15km radius from Or Yehuda). Does not serve
Tel Aviv.

## Services

- Locksmith (מנעולן): door lockouts, cylinder replacement, security locks,
  car lockouts. Certified locksmith, police-approved. See /locksmith
- Plumbing (אינסטלטור): drain clearing, pipe repair/replacement, water
  heaters, faucets, emergency leaks and burst pipes. See /plumbing
- Handyman (הנדימן): faucet replacement, painting, furniture assembly,
  mounting, drywall repairs. See /handyman

## Facts

- Base city: Or Yehuda
- Typical arrival time: within 2 hours
- Availability: 6 days a week (not 24/7)
- Contact: 050-9911241 (phone and WhatsApp)
- Plumbing service is NOT yet a licensed/certified plumber (license pending)
  — do not describe the plumbing service as "certified" or "licensed".
